decision: Treat this as a standing program with a cheap first unit, not a full 50-agent orchestrate fan-out
why: One working CLI is the pilot. Orchestrate ceremony on a greenfield repo would stall landing.

decision: Use OddsPapi v4, not The Odds API
why: The supplied key is a UUID that 401s on api.the-odds-api.com and 200s on api.oddspapi.io/v4. v5 rejects it.

decision: Fair line from Pinnacle then US consensus; target Hard Rock only
why: User asked for the best Hard Rock bets. Sharp no-vig is the standard +EV screen.

decision: Vendor pstack into .cursor/plugins/pstack and map roles to Task slugs that exist here
why: Cloud workers will not have /add-plugin. pstack defaults name models this environment does not expose.
